content.text: I compared the outward-issued plan against the agreed test concept in both directions. It is below the concept: two of four workflows carry no per-environment sign-off record, which the concept requires. That is owed and it is invisible in a plan that reads complete — H6 fails. Recording a HOLD with the punch-list.
